subject: science
title: Push or Pull?
about: Sorting everyday actions into pushes and pulls, the first idea in NC's Grade 1 forces standard (PS.1.1.1). Every force a first grader meets is one or the other.
tip: Act each one out together: push the chair, pull the drawer, then ask which it was.

cards.q: You kick a ball. Is that a push or a pull?
cards.note: A push moves a thing away from you. A pull brings it toward you.

cards.q: You open a drawer. Push or pull?
cards.note: The drawer comes toward you, so it is a pull.

cards.q: You tug a rope in tug-of-war. Push or pull?
cards.note: The rope comes toward you, so it is a pull.

cards.q: You roll a shopping cart along in front of you. Push or pull?
cards.note: The cart moves away from you, so it is a push.

cards.q: You drag a sled behind you. Push or pull?
cards.note: The sled follows you, so it is a pull.

cards.q: You press a doorbell. Push or pull?
cards.note: Your finger pushes the button in.

cards.q: You zip up your coat. Push or pull?
cards.note: You pull the zipper tab up.

cards.q: You roll a bowling ball down the lane. Push or pull?
cards.note: Your hand pushes the ball away from you.

cards.q: You pick a flower off its stem. Push or pull?
cards.note: You pull the flower toward you, off the stem.

cards.q: A big dog drags you along by its leash. Push or pull?
cards.note: The dog pulls you toward it. Animals can push and pull too.

cards.q: You pedal a bike with your feet. Push or pull?
cards.note: Your feet push the pedals down.

cards.q: You shove a book away from you across the table. Push or pull?
cards.note: Away from you means a push.

cards.q: A magnet grabs a paper clip. Push or pull?
cards.note: The magnet pulls the clip to it without touching it first.

cards.q: You reel in a fish on a line. Push or pull?
cards.note: The line brings the fish toward you.

cards.q: You throw a ball. Push or pull?
cards.note: Your hand pushes the ball away.

cards.q: You hammer a nail. Push or pull?
cards.note: The hammer pushes the nail into the wood.
